positive: Weak, diffuse positives on scattered multilingual tokens (Chinese compounds ending in 的 like 构成的/建造的, Vietnamese/Korean tokens, UI/web words like 'Save', 'POST', 'Sec', 'opting'); possibly abstract intent/purpose words ('intention', 'aspire', 'Understanding', 'Reduce').
negative: Science/biology word-starts and short subword prefixes: ' cy'/' cyt' (cytokine, cytoplasm), ' anthrop', ' bark', ' iron'/'Iron', 'volt'/'Volt', ' cortisol', ' tit', ' ed', ' SI', ' TH', ' XL'; also ' population', ' additional'/' extra'. Strongest on first subword of technical biology/chemistry/physics terms.

positive: Possessive determiners of first person and 'own': ' our', ' my', 'Our', 'OUR', '我们的', '我的', '自己的', 'own' and other-language equivalents (свои, propria, nostro, notre). Fires on the possessive, often predicting a reflexive/'own' continuation (e.g. 'our own', 'by ourselves', 'for yourself'). Strongest in first-person persuasive/blog text ('in our own lives', 'my own experience').
negative: Weak; list/listing contexts ('list', ' listed', '看看'), product/noun-plural words (' peripherals', ' souvenirs', ' mates', ' instincts'), code tokens like '=np', 'Iterator', '(per'. Generic object nouns not preceded by possessives.

positive: Marketing/service-provider text addressing the reader or speaking as an organization: 'our specialists/experts', 'professional', 'your questions', 'for you', 'our company', service-system language (专业, 专家, 服务体系, специалисты, 'help you'); positive on expert/professional nouns.
negative: Casual, narrative or first-person anecdotal text: 'got', 'keep', 'hid', 'like' (就像), 'new' (新, 的新), 'want', colloquial Chinese particles (啦, 肯定, 跟他), personal 'my/I found'. Also capitalized fragments 'Th', 'Aut', 'Show', markdown '##'.

positive: The word zero and its variants (' zero', 'Zero', 'ZERO', '零', ' cero', '-zero', ' zeros'), especially in math reasoning ('equals zero', 'set to zero', 'remainder is 0'); also 'Idle', concessive 'although/尽管'.
negative: Process/attempt/time-boundary words: ' attempt', ' until'/'直到', ' once', ' shift', ' window(s)', ' tap', ' ground', ' probes', 'Stein'/'Einstein', 'Capital'. Contexts like 'until the ...', 'once you ...', 'attempt to'.

positive: Exclusion words: ' excluded', ' Exclude', ' excluding', ' exclu-', 'Ignore'; also 'toBe', ' Direct', ' subsidiary', 'rendering'. Contexts like 'excluding tax', 'is excluded from'.
negative: Sector/industry/field words across languages: ' sector'/' secteur'/' setor'/' sektor'/'сектора', 'ngành', 'المجالات', 'क्षेत्र'; plus Chinese prestige/attraction words (吸引, 享誉, 举世, 致富) and ' deny'. Economic-sector descriptions ('the manufacturing sector').

positive: Approximation/likelihood/closeness words: ' likely', ' approximately', ' approx', ' closely', ' accurately', ' predominantly', ' primarily', ' plausible', ' suggests', '接近', '近似', '相近'. Contexts like 'most likely', 'closest to', 'approximately equal', 'which answer is closest'; output pushes 'most/best' so it fires in 'the ___ likely/appropriate' setups and multiple-choice reasoning ('the best/closest answer').
negative: Explicit superlative tokens themselves: '最', ' smallest', ' fastest', ' shortest', ' safest', ' lowest', ' best'/'BEST', 'most', '最小', 'ที่สุด', '唯一'. Math 'find the smallest/least value' contexts.

positive: 'Let'/'let' introducing a variable or assumption in math: 'Let x be the number of...', 'Let's denote', 'Suppose', 'denote', '设', '令', '假设', 'Пусть'. Very strong in math word-problem solutions at the start of a setup sentence; suppresses predicting another 'let'.
negative: First-person plural hortatory/modal phrasing without 'let': ' we', 'We', 'we can/should/will', '我们可以', '我们应该', 'please', 'podemos/можем/allons'. E.g. 'We can calculate...', 'we need to', 'Please...'. Also 'let us together' (让我们一起) motivational text.

positive: The 'text' token inside LaTeX commands \text{...} and \mathrm{...} (e.g. '\text{cm}', '\text{ dollars}', '\mathrm{kg}'), also code 'text' fields (.text, _text, (text). Output strongly predicts a following backslash, i.e. another LaTeX command. Strongest in math solutions with units in LaTeX.
negative: Weak; Greek-letter/math symbol tokens without \text (' π', ' ω', ' Γ', ' sqrt'), and words like ' micro', ' min', ' Rose', ' Tell', ' suspension', ' Reserve'.

positive: Physical quantity/measurement words: speed (' Speed', '时速', '.speed'), thickness/'spessore', slope (坡度), 'OVER', 'pop', single capital variable 'C'/'_C' and lowercase ' f'; plus some proper names (López, Philipp, Mário).
negative: Kind/type determiners: '这种', '某种', '哪种', '那种', '某个', ' common'/'Common'; single-letter ' D'/' d'/' X', ordinal Chinese (第十, 第三种), semicolons ';;'/' ;', '合理'.

positive: Tokens like ' POST'/'posta', ' journey', ' follow'/'Follow', ' harbor', ' STEM', ' ERA', and close-paren-plus-char sequences in code/math: ')m', ')%', ')b', ')>', '])=='. Also 'four'/'fours', ' her'.
negative: Polite request words: 'Please'/' please'/'请'/'请用'; '唯' (only); short prefixes ' FI'/' fi', ' whe', ' pros', ' vide', 'BE', 'GE', 'FD'; the digit '4' (incl. fullwidth '４'); ' ≈'.
